name: Qube Browser 0.1.12-alpha
notes:
Fixed
- Ad and content blockers now block. uBlock Origin Lite works.
- Extension popups are sized from their content. Some opened too wide, showing
  a strip of the extension's own background down the right.
- Reopening a popup no longer shows the previous popup's picture, stretched,
  until the new one arrives.
- Extensions can register protocol handlers again.
- Removed a startup flag that disabled Chromium's internal safety checks across
  the engine.
- Release notes now appear in this window.

Known
- Extension popups take about a second to appear, longer for some.
summary: Ad and content blockers now work. Extensions were never placed in the network path, so a blocker would load, run and block nothing.
